organization.description: The GitHub organization name to manage. Use this field instead of `owner` when managing organization accounts.

owner.description: The GitHub owner name to manage. Use this field instead of `organization` when managing individual accounts.

token.description: The PAT used to connect to GitHub. Anonymous mode is enabled if `token` is not set.

author.description: `object({ name=string, email=string, message=string })` Defines the commit user and message.

branch.description: This is the branch the files will commit into. The branch must exist.

force_new.description: Ensure your files are always pushed into the branch. If the branch is generated in the apply and doesn't exist yet set this to true

hostname.description: Defaults to `github.com` but since this is pure git change to whatever server you are committing into.

organization.description: Sets the organization in git the repository is in.

project.description: Sets the AzureDevOps Project where the repository is in. Only needed if using AzDO repos

repository.description: Respository name you want to commit into.

contents.description: String contents of this file. Bested used with templates

filepath.description: Relative path to the file in the targeted repository.
